text: Darkness. Then, slowly, a soft and sourceless light.

You are dead. You know it the way you know your own name: without being told, and without being able to say how. There is no pain, only a vast quiet with no walls in it, and the sense that you are no longer alone.
Easy. There is no hurry here. You have died, and I am sorry for it, because it was not your time.
That is rare, and it is why you are still here. The living world is still open to you. I cannot give you a destiny, but I can give you a beginning, a second life.
I will ask who you wish to become, and what gifts you wish to carry back. Then I will send you home, and most of this place will fade from you. First: what is your name?
